arguments.sql_query:
WITH pmo AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS pmo_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4010333
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
drug_classes AS (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'anabolic' AS class
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1594148,1511251,1521987)
  UNION
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'oral_bisphosphonate' AS class
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1557272,1516800,1512480)
),
exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, dc.class, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_date, CASE WHEN dc.class='anabolic' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS rn
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_classes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN pmo ON pmo.person_id = de.person_id AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= pmo.pmo_date
  JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = de.person_id
  WHERE p.gender_concept_id = 8532
    AND DATEDIFF(year, p.birth_datetime, de.drug_exposure_start_date) >= 50
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT person_id, class, index_date FROM exposures WHERE rn=1
),
fracture_admit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON vo.person_id = c.person_id
    AND vo.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262, 8717)
    AND vo.visit_start_date > c.index_date
    AND vo.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 180, c.index_date)
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = c.person_id
    AND co.visit_occurrence_id = vo.visit_occurrence_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 75053
)
SELECT c.class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fa.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fracture_admission_patients,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fa.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS risk_pct
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN fracture_admit fa ON fa.person_id = c.person_id
GROUP BY c.class
ORDER BY c.class;
